title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme (PM-KISAN):
summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Scheme (PM-KISAN):

items:  Objective: To provide financial support to farmers for meeting short-term needs and boosting
 Benefits: ₹6,000 annually in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each, directly transferred to bank accounts.
 Eligibility: All landholder farmer families. 11 crore farmers eligible across India.
 Ineligible: Public representatives, ministers, pensioners earning over ₹10,000/month, income
 Exclusions: Those holding constitutional posts and income tax payers.
